_comment: Source of truth for tools/sync-clickup.js. Derived from docs/state.md and docs/trace.md on 2026-09-07. Each task's `clickupId` is written back by the sync script — never edit that field by hand, or the next run will create a duplicate instead of updating.

tasks.name: Platform & Auth — scaffold, users, roles, JWT
tasks.description: Express bootstrap, MongoDB single-node replica set (rs0), User + RoleAssignment models, local login (spec 010 FR-006, FR-007), the break-glass administrator (E-07). SSO (SAML/OIDC) is an uncovered MUST — see docs/trace.md.

tasks.name: Audit writer — append-only, atomic, reconciled
tasks.description: utils/audit.js: every mutation writes an immutable entry inside the same transaction as the mutation (spec 010 FR-008, E-11). Append-only enforced by mongoose hooks (AS-08). tools: npm run audit:reconcile detects orphaned entries and unaudited records; not a stub, verified with injected faults.

tasks.name: Scope predicate — branch + department (Team scoped out)
tasks.description: utils/scope.js: the single place scope is decided (constitution IV, spec 010 FR-004/FR-005/FR-021). Out-of-scope reads answer 404, never 403 (AS-01). Team is scoped out per decision 20 — tickets assign directly to an agent. See docs/decisions-pending.md §7 and §0 decision 20.

tasks.name: Platform module — branches, departments, localised values
tasks.description: Branch and Department models, bilingual localized-text subdocument (spec 012 FR-004, constitution I — refuses a single-language save). Departments are flat (decision 2); isolated entities not supported (decision 1).

tasks.name: Bilingual UI — runtime language switch, Arabic typography
tasks.description: LanguageService + translate pipe, no reload, no @angular/localize (spec 012 FR-001, AS-01). No-fallback rule enforced (AS-03). Cairo self-hosted for correct Arabic joining (AS-06).

tasks.name: Customer model — bilingual split, scope, decision 16
tasks.description: Customer + ContactPoint models. displayName is user-authored single-language, not localised. FR-004 relaxed to unique-by-default-overridable (decision 16) rather than a hard unique index. scopeCoordinate() declared, not inferred.

tasks.name: Customer CRUD — create, search, detail, update
tasks.description: POST /customer (FR-001, FR-010 collision override, organisation-target type check), GET /customer search (ranked match list, decision 7), GET /customer/:id, PATCH /customer/:id (FR-020, one audit entry per changed field).

tasks.name: Outbound-on-shared-contact-point refusal (E-15)
tasks.description: 001 E-15: outbound on a shared contact point MUST be refused, no fallback to any one customer's consent. Specified, not built — there is no outbound messaging code yet (spec 003 is out of scope). Blocked on 001 [CLARIFY-5] (consent scope).

tasks.name: Ticket model — status set, transition graph, reference sequence
tasks.description: Ticket + Message + Counter models. Ten ratified statuses (decisions 14-15), decision-22 default transition graph, TKT-YYYY-NNNNN atomic reference counter (E-16). Team dropped (decision 20), category is a flat string (decision 21).

tasks.name: Ticket CRUD — create, list/filter, detail, assign, status
tasks.description: POST /ticket (FR-001/AS-01), GET /ticket with filters, GET /ticket/:id (thread + history), PATCH /ticket/:id/assign (FR-009/FR-010/AS-06, reason required), PATCH /ticket/:id/status (FR-007/FR-008/AS-03), POST /ticket/:id/message (FR-014/AS-07).

tasks.name: Root cause / resolution code lists (FR-029)
tasks.description: requiresResolutionFields is false on every status today (decision 23) — the two admin-authored bilingual lists were not built. FR-029/AS-13 are unenforced until they exist.

tasks.name: Angular — customer list & detail
tasks.description: Search (ranked match, E-13 floor at 3 chars), detail with contact points, entitlement panel rendering 'unavailable' honestly (constitution III), in-place field edit.

tasks.name: Angular — ticket list, detail, create
tasks.description: List with server-side filters, detail with thread/status/assignment/history, create form. Status options and reachable transitions always read from the server (FR-008) — the client holds no local copy of the graph.

tasks.name: SPEC DEFECT — Team entity undefined
tasks.description: Team is referenced as Required on Ticket.owning_team_id and Department.default_team_id by specs 002 and 012, and defined as an entity by none of the 13 specs. No [CLARIFY] marker exists for it. Scoped out for today's build (decision 20); NOT resolved. See docs/decisions-pending.md §7.

tasks.name: SCOPED OUT — Email / WhatsApp / SMS / chat (spec 003)
tasks.description: Blocked by 003 [CLARIFY-1]: which channels ship in phase one. Six open markers total in spec 003.

tasks.name: SCOPED OUT — SLA & automation engine (spec 005)
tasks.description: Blocked by 005 [CLARIFY-1] (SLA hours/minutes) and [CLARIFY-2] (business calendars per branch). utils/elapsed-time.js exists and returns { status: 'unavailable' } by design until these unblock.

tasks.name: SCOPED OUT — Knowledge base (spec 006)
tasks.description: Not started this pass. Five open markers, led by 006 [CLARIFY-1] (peer languages vs primary+translation for articles), which also depends on 012 [CLARIFY-1].

tasks.name: SCOPED OUT — Customer portal (spec 008)
tasks.description: Blocked by 008 [CLARIFY-1]: portal authentication method (one-time code, password, or SSO) and whether anonymous submission is permitted.

tasks.name: SCOPED OUT — Reports & management (spec 009)
tasks.description: Not started. Depends on the SLA engine (spec 005) for every duration figure, per constitution III. Reopen rate is flagged degenerate while decision 9 (no auto-close) stands — see docs/trace.md.

tasks.name: SCOPED OUT — ERP integration (spec 011)
tasks.description: Ownership resolved (decision 6: CRM is the system of record, ERP read-only). The integration itself is not built — blocked by 011 [CLARIFY-2]: which ERP, which version, what surface it exposes.

tasks.name: SCOPED OUT — AI features (spec 007)
tasks.description: Nothing to be built. 007 [CLARIFY-1] blocks the entire spec, and constitution V (AI proposes, a human disposes) forbids planning it further until model, hosting and residency are answered.

tasks.name: API documentation — Swagger/OpenAPI + Postman
tasks.description: swagger-jsdoc + swagger-ui-express at /api-docs, JSDoc above each route. npm run docs:build -> docs/openapi.json, npm run docs:postman -> Postman collection + environment via openapi-to-postmanv2. Login test script auto-saves the token.
